In the late 20th century, there was an urban legend about pet alligators getting flushed down the toilet and growing to adulthood in sewers.  This large specimen doesn't look like it sees humans as anything other than a meal.
The timber rattlesnake is the most venomous viper native to New England.  Climatic changes have extended its range far into the north.
A mutated timber rattlesnake, about three times as large as the norm.  While it isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is more aggressive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.
An aggressive mutant variety of the worm snake, turned pale yellow from its underground life.  It swarms beneath the ground and is named for its habit of infesting sewer lines.
A black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.
A gigantic black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.  Other blobs seem to swarm around it.
A large black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.
A small black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.
A formless slime mold the size of a cow.  Crusty bits of cytoplasm fall away as it oozes across the ground.
A familiar-looking blob of goo.  It sprouts the occasional eyestalk.

A sluglike creature, eight feet long and the width of a refrigerator.  Its black body glistens as it oozes its way along the ground.  Eye stalks occasionally push their way out of the oily mass and look around.
A mutated leopard slug, as wide as a golf cart.  Venom dripping from its fanged maw, it slithers ahead slowly, leaving a trail of glistening slime.
A short fat stalk with broad leaves and tiny flower buds.
A thick stalk that rises five feet from the ground and has heavy broad leaves at its base.  Purple flower buds adorn the top.
A drooped, quivering plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are closed, and pulsate ominously.

A small triffid, only a few feet tall.  It has not yet developed bark, but its sting is still sharp and deadly.
A creeping animate plant, growing as tall as a moose.  It has a single bark-covered stalk supporting a flowery head with a paralyzing sting concealed within.
A ponderous and particularly arborescent triffid.  It has enormous red petals surrounded by a haze of spores, and two thick barbed vines stick out from the stems like wary harpoons.
An animated mass of roots and vines, creeping along the ground with alarming speed.  The tangle is thick enough that the center from which they grow is concealed.
A stout woody plant that can dig through the ground and flick spines from its branches.  The thorns carry a fungicidal compound with paralytic effects.

attack_effs.//: applying this multiple times makes intensity go up by 3 instead of 1

death_drops.//: 80% chance of an item from group fungal_sting

data.description: A giant plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are open with ominous shine in center.
A knot of tubular roots, flowing with sap and beating like a heart.  Strands of vascular tissue reach out to the surrounding root walls.
Three high-powered searchlights with automated search AI and mounting, continually seeking targets.
The TX-5LR Cerberus is an upgrade to its predecessors.  It features a state of the art revolving laser cannon system with three barrels that charge from solar cells embedded in its hull.

These TALON-derived riot control platforms were widely publicized a few years before the cataclysm as a new semi-autonomous device that could fire less-lethal rounds with far more accuracy than a human, ensuring safer hits against a target's limbs.  They were quickly adopted by prisons and inner city police forces, where they demonstrated that 'less lethal' is not the same as 'non-lethal'.  In the days before the cataclysm, massive stockrooms of the things were put into circulation.  On the bright side, although it shoots autonomously, it requires a human operator to relocate, so it's not so mobile anymore.

special_attacks.//: For later: needs the ability to preferentially target legs and arms
special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Universal curfew is in effect.  Please return to your home.  This unit is authorized to open fire."

data.description: The General Atomics TX-1 Guardian, an popular automated turret equipped with a 9mm carbine.  Initially it was designed mainly for corporate property protection and police needs, however due to its popularity, it ended up being used even for military needs.  Its high-quality targeting system allows it to engage targets even at medium range.

The General Atomics TX-5 Sentinel, an automated milspec turret equipped with a 5.56mm gun.  A direct upgrade of original TX-1 Guardian for military use.  Designed to efficiently take down enemy personnel protected by body armor at medium range.

The General Atomics TX-7 Sniper, an automated milspec turret equipped with a 7.62x51mm gun.  Designed as a counter-sniper turret to cover the vulnerability of TX-5 Sentinel to sniper fire.  Its advanced target recognition system and 7.62x51mm gun allows it to engage targets protected by modern body armor at very long range.

A quadcopter drone largely comprised of a high-resolution camera lens and a speaker, this robot hovers above the ground, documenting the carnage and mayhem around it.  While it is no longer able to report to a central authority, it's likely that some of its automated alert systems are still functional, given that the thing seems to have an operational charging station somewhere.

A popular product from Uncanny, this friendly android can carry your bag or push your Grocery Cart for you.  You know it's friendly because its human face is constantly smiling at you.  According to the ads it uses a state-machine of a complexity never seen before, Uncanny even hired professional actors to record its lines.  Examine to befriend.
A busted grocery bot, it can still carry your bag but its arms are too damaged to push a Grocery Cart.  Despite its current state it's still smiling at you.  Examine to befriend.
The Ford Sanitron, a utility robot designed for cleaning up waste material in hazardous conditions.

A mule-sized, quadrupedal robot designed for commercial and military use.  Capable of carrying fairly heavy loads for its size, autonomously stumbling about and surveying the terrain with its various cameras.  Not very useful after the apocalypse, unless it has been reprogrammed to receive commands from a new user.
A snake-like, segmented robot built to tunnel into the ground and detonate landmines.

data.//: nurse_bot and nurse_bot_defective look very similar, part of the trick is figuring out which one is the good one.  So the sprites should probably look pretty similar to not give it away immediately
data.description: The first product from Uncanny, a towering four-armed humanoid with a gentle face.  The details of its visage are striking, but the stiffness of it makes you really uncomfortable.  The end of the world did not stop it from looking for patient to assist.

data.//: nurse_bot and nurse_bot_defective look very similar, part of the trick is figuring out which one is the good one.  So the sprites should probably look pretty similar to not give it away immediately
data.description: The first product from Uncanny, a towering four-armed humanoid with a gentle face.  The details of its visage are striking, but the stiffness of it makes you really uncomfortable.  The end of the world did not stop it from looking for patient to assist.
A once aggressive and hungry bull shark, this jawed terror is now even more aggressive, possibly thanks to its lack of a functioning brain.
The deformed, animated corpse of a canine, a sinewy beast which can easily outpace its two-legged friends.

This once-canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  Devoid entirely of flesh, this walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with glistening black goo.
A zombified version of one of the German shepherd dogs used in law enforcement.  Its deformed body is encased in a protective Kevlar harness.

death_drops.//: 40% chance of an item from group dog_cop

data.description: Acrid smell accompanies this corpse of canine.  Its whole body is covered in chains of pulsing cysts and slime-dribbling ulcers.
A zombified wolf.  Its mouth oozes with a black substance, coating the vicious-looking white fangs.
This black bear's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  It shuffles as it walks.
A zombified omnivore descended from the wild boar.  Now it's got black goo all over it, instead of mud.
data.//: 1d8->2d5, minor bonus over 1d9

data.description: This wall-eyed beast has a large wound on its side, and ribs with some flesh on them are seen through it.  The most prominent feature of this abomination is large incisors in its ominously open mouth, strange black goo is oozing out of it.  Seems like it isn't interested in trees anymore and is looking for some warm flesh to feed.

This formerly-majestic moose has succumbed to the infection which is killing the world.  Shiny green blowflies swarm the vast suppurated patches of purulent flesh where its skin has sloughed away, and its remaining fur is black and matted with necrotic discharge.
An otherwise normal-looking cougar, except that its hind legs are swollen, and its eyes bulge with black goo.
A deformed human body, its skin transformed into one thick, calloused envelope of scar tissue.

death_drops.//: cloth as any other zombie (always), additional items from group hive (sometimes)

data.description: A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage visible in its oily black eyes.
A human body covered by a weather-beaten and badly damaged set of riot gear.
data.//: Matches armor values of riot armor.

data.description: This human corpse drags itself along slowly with its arms.  Its legs are damaged beyond repair.
data.//: Like with most standard zeds with an attack_cost defined, this makes them move way slower than normal zombies but attack at about the same general speed.

data.description:
The foulest stench is in the air,
The funk of forty thousand years,
And grisly ghouls from every tomb,
Are closing in to seal your doom!

The dancer doesn't even notice you, it seems like something nearby is controlling it.
Stumbling as it moves, this corpse of an overweight human regards its surroundings with an empty black gaze.
A decaying human body clad in tattered firefighting gear.  It staggers aimlessly, reeking of smoke and decay.
data.//: Armor values match that of turnout coat.

data.description: This zombie's face and body is completely covered by a protective suit.  It wanders around, unsteadily.
A once-dead human corpse.  Its discolored swollen flesh is riddled with festering wounds and open sores.

data.name: SWAT zombie
data.description: This zombie was part of a specialized unit of law enforcement.  It still wears a battered armor with the SWAT logo emblazoned on the front.
data.//: Armor values match that of kevlar vest.

data.description: Once an athletic human, now a brutal monster.  Its facial features are twisted into an expression of pure rage.
This zombie is rather sleek and barely clothed.
This zombie looks beefed and is dressed in the tattered remnants of a security uniform.
This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.
This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: The pupating zombie crawler bursts, and gore-smeared winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

This human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: The pupating zombie bursts, and gore-smeared winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

special_attacks.monster_message: The pupating zombie bursts, and shadowy winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome fleshy membrane.  The mutation does not suit it well: it moves clumsily, even compared to other zombies.
data.//: In the future, it would be nice if these guys could be resistant to fall damage.

data.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome fleshy membrane.  The rest has become emaciated, thin rope-like muscles ripping through taut flesh.  While it doesn't appear to be able to truly fly, it uses its mutated arms to make shockingly fast leaps through the air.
data.//: Slow at actual movement, made up for by its rapid leaps.  This should work to simulate its clumsy form.  When charge attacks are possible it should get one, and that will be its main damaging ability.

data.description: This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a sheer jagged spike.  It looks like nothing you've seen on Earth, and yet strangely like it was made of human parts.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of three flapping wings connected to a jagged pointed object.
This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a jagged spike and a bloated fleshy belly.
This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a jagged spike with a pulsing electrical glow.
A sickly-looking dead one.  Its skin looks especially thin, with a sticky, yellow fluid flowing through the clearly visible veins.

This body has swollen to immense proportions, but still manages to hold itself together with semi-congealed acid all over its bloated body.  It clumsily moves around, but attacks with a large reserve of acid.

special_attacks.description: The corrosive zombie spits a glob of acid!

data.description: A hunched human body with its eyes pushed up into its forehead and drooping cheeks, most of its face is occupied by a puckered mouth.  Its stomach is swollen and nearly translucent, with a sickly yellow tint.
A degenerate corpse, shambling as it walks.  Several junks and waste materials have unified into its skin and wounds around it reeks in black goo.
data.//: Higher weight from attached junks.

data.description: A tiny charred body, jumping and kicked and flailing around in a mockery of playground exercise.  It does not need a face for you to feel bad about killing it.
Charred zombie with bony plates, spikes and protrusions.  Moves stiffly, but swiftly.
Heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred flesh.  Its flesh has mended into a leathery shell.
This horrifying little mutated wretch looks to have once been a child, but its massive gaping jaws are now far more suggestive of a predatory beast.
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.

death_drops.//: default zombie children clothing (always), additional items from child_items (sometimes)

data.description: What was once a child is now a mutant beast with blackened skin and massive eyes.  This abomination's vile form makes mockery of its human origin.
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: This heavily mutated child zombie twitches and flails its limbs in painful looking spasms as it runs about.
data.//: GUILT because it still looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: This swollen, gooey looking mutant child looks bad, even for a zombie.  Maybe that's why it seems to want a hug so badly.
data.//: GUILT because it still looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: This crouching child-mutant's face is dominated by a pair of huge black eyes and its fingertips end in sharp claws.
data.//: no GUILT because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: Undeath has not been kind to the children of the apocalypse.  This one is little more than a reanimated membrane of skin stretched across tiny brittle bones.
data.//: GUILT because it still looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: A huge beast covered in visible scarring from what you can only guess was 'research'.  Being near it, you can hear a slight humming, like that of an electrical transformer.
A human body with pale blue flesh, crackling with electrical energy.

This once-human is visible only as a glowing white silhouette that you have to squint to see, cloaked in a crackling field of lightning that pulses like a beating heart.  It walks slowly and deliberately, the thunderstorm surrounding it eagerly jumping to anything conductive within its grasp.
data.//: slow walk speed - intimidating!
data.//2: melee damage is quite weak since the shockfield around it is its most dangerous function

data.description: A very pale dead body with the worst case of static hair you have ever seen.  Sometimes, you can see sparks of electricity around it.
A rotund human body, bloated beyond belief and layered in rolls of fat.  It emits a horrible odor, and a putrid pink sludge dribbles from its mouth.
This boomer, normally swollen and ready to burst, has strengthened and solidified.  The bile dribbling from its mouth also appears to have changed…
A huge bloated zombie that appears to have fed upon gasoline; fumes and flames escape from its mouth and fuel leaks from its waddling form.
With its gray skin swollen to near rupture with putrid gas, this cyst covered zombie looks like it could violently burst under the slightest of disturbances.

data.//: Heads up: these zombies are pending removal sometime before 0.E.
data.description: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear.  Its hands constantly fumble at its many pouches.
Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and wearing a MOLLE pack.  Its hands quickly open and close its many pouches.
A conglomeration of human parts fused together in a horrible mishmash of function, slowly dragging its eldritch body across the ground.
Human bodies fused together into a colossus with heads and limbs sticking out of its bloated body.  You may have trouble estimating its healthiness and its capabilities might change.

A great tendril of mutated flesh and sharpened bone.  Emergent from a crevice in the ruined floor, hundreds of human limbs seek freedom and writhe incessantly from underneath its grotesque carapace.  As enormous as it may already be, you feel certain that this is just part of a creature much bigger, for when it moves, you can feel this whole ruin tremble, as if an unseen giant struggled against the weight of its concrete tomb.
Immobile from grievous wounds, its gray skin has bloated to near rupture with putrid gas.  Between lumps of unrecognizable gore, a human head lamely follows your walking with empty, black eyes.
A nightmarish spidery abomination, born from human gore.  It deftly crawls between walls and ceiling with limbs grown from its own disjointed ribs.
A corpse hideously twisted into an insect-like form.  A hollow tendril reaches out from its open thorax.
A great lump of mutated flesh.  It resembles the innards of some gigantic creature and is covered in a grid of diminutive veins.

Apart from the jet-black eyes, this zombie looks less decomposed and inhuman than most.  Clad in a tattered lab coat, it seems to have a glimmer of awareness - not a human awareness, but something more sinister.  As you watch it, its movements look almost marionette-like.
data.//: zombie scientists are recognised as friendly by the lab's defense system

data.description: A shambling human corpse wearing a gray uniform and bulletproof vest with "SECURITY" emblazoned across the front.  It looks like the guard was quite physically fit before its death; it moves quickly and powerfully, albeit clumsily.
data.//: guards are recognised as friendly by the lab's defense system
data.//2: Matches armor values of kevlar vest.

data.description: Instead of one of its forearms, this zombie has a muscular tube ending in a stinger that is moist with stringy slime.  It is single-mindedly focused on using just that one limb to fight.
A dripping stinger where one hand would be, a set of razor-like claws in place of the other one.  This zombie's cold, focused eyes look down at you from above a "mask" of melded flesh.

This humanoid has a long bone "syringe" in place of one forearm, a large saw as the opposing hand, and a pair of digitigrade legs ending in raptor-like feet.  Its head is featureless, except for its "human" eyes, which smile with inhuman malice and scorn.
A distorted and swollen human body.  Its jaws have elongated into a crocodile like snout, dripping with foul smelling saliva.

data.//: This is the brainless zombie.  Has nohead flag to reflect the head is already catastrophically damaged.  Only detects through hearing.
data.description: A zombie like any other, except that its features and skull have been devastated.  It's unclear what caused the damage, but between the scraps of flesh you can see that its face and brain are gone, though its ears are intact.
data.//2: Weight and volume reduced to reflect missing head parts.  Based on average headsize/weight, but are not exact.
data.//3: Lower hp to reflect previous damage.  Plus they're virtually useless so might as well make them a quick kill.
data.//4: Removed Bite attack to reflect damage to mouth.

data.description: Its entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.
A slab of festering muscle the size of a well-toned bodybuilder.  Seems eager to strangle the life from you.
Somehow this brute hides in the dark like some kind of boogeyman.  Very agile for such a large zombie.

data.//: Upgraded version of brainless.  Regenerating Skull with huge ears.
data.description: The head of this zombie was once obviously destroyed, the gaps in its scraps of face now filling with a peculiar gray goo.  Human ears hang from the sides, enormous and unsettling.  Thin slits at the front suggest it may be able to see.
data.//2: Weight and volume changed to reflect a (mostly) lack of head.
data.//3: Removed Bite as this creature does not have a 'mouth'.

data.description: A deformed human body, once living.  Its arms dangle from its sides like the limbs of some skinless ape, mindlessly groping at their surroundings.
An undead humanoid, its elongated arms drag along the ground as it moves.  It looks to almost have a hunch from the swollen back and shoulder muscles tearing though its skin.

Black hollow eyes survey the surroundings as the zombie stretches and bends in ways that whoever the original body belonged to never could.  The only thing that seems solid, on this flexible black-veined body, is the rows of sharp black teeth.  You get the feeling that the only human thing remaining is the skin, worn as one would wear clothes.
A human body now swollen to the size of six men, with arms as wide as a trash can.
This once-human body is barely recognizable, scrambling about on all fours, its nails and teeth both sharpened into dangerous looking spikes.

And though you fight to stay alive,
Your body starts to shiver.
For no mere mortal can resist,
The evil of the thriller.
With a crocodile-like snout and rows of protruding teeth, this swimwear-clad zombie lurks in the water.

Once human, its features have tightened, its lips pulled back into an unnatural grin, revealing rows of blackened teeth beneath its large, piercing eyes.  It stands tall and its movements are fluid and tightly controlled.  A feeling of danger permeates the air around it, and the light that falls on it seems somehow harsher and more glaring.

A twisted mockery of the human form, emaciated, with jet black skin and glowing red eyes.  It is somehow painful to look at, awakening fears deep within your psyche, and even the air around it seems more sinister, somehow darker and more dangerous.
This recently-risen body moves quickly, darting its head back and forth and gnawing at its hands.
data.//: A basic zombie is 70 speed, not exactly enough to fully offset the speed difference but will make them fast at running but less so at attacking.

data.description: With its joints in odd places and angles, this humanoid creature prowls across the landscape with surprising speed.  Its teeth and arms are sharpened into fine points, and black ooze seeps out from cuts between its muscles.
A thin corpse, its chest is swollen in what appears to be preparation.  A thick black ooze drips from its open mouth.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is its shambling, human shaped outline.

Living in the woods,
killing for sport,
eating all the bodies,
actual cannibal Shia LaBeouf.
An elongated human body with a swollen chest and a gaping hole where its jaw used to be.

data.//: Highest upgrade of brainless/ear zombie.  Still immune to headshots, as there's nothing critical there.
data.description: This creature's head is a hideous gray skull, formed of human bone fragments and some sort of goo.  Jagged teeth are visible as the thing works its jaw and disturbingly human, lidless eyes stare at you from their sockets.  The thing's fleshy ears are four sizes too large and droop under their own weight.
A blackened and twisted naked human body, strips of flesh hang from its body, and it emits a constant haze of thick black smoke.
A slick and glistening human body.  Its hands and feet are webbed, and it is clad in swimwear.
Still wearing its work clothes and hardhat, this zombie likely used to work on power lines or other electrical equipment.
This zombie's face, hands, work clothes, and miner's helmet are fully covered with stains of coal dust.

A shambling undead humanoid, body overgrown with a tangled mass of otherworldly vegetation.  Hunched over and dragging its feet as it moves, the bramble utterly enveloping its upper half twitches and moves with a life of its own, tendrils tipped with a paralytic sting.
Apparently this zombie was doing time when the Cataclysm struck.  It wears black and white striped prisoner clothes, and tattoos can be seen on his decaying skin.
Intense radiation has spurred a unique form of necrosis and regeneration, it is impossible to tell if this creature was ever human.
This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.
This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.
This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.
This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

A monstrous overgrowth of ossified tissue has replaced this zombie's rotting skin with an organic armor of dense bone.  Large clumps of black goo seep from its joints as it shambles aimlessly, with sickening crackling sounds filling the air around it.

data.//: Skelly brute gaps the evolution between normal and the juggernaut.
data.description: Distorted outgrowths of calcified bone plates cover this zombie's rotten skin.  Joints and cracks around its body ooze with black goo.
Heavy, jagged bone plates have grown out of the surface of this zombie.  Underneath, its flesh glows and crackles with the occasional jolt of electricity.

This hideous golem of plated bones and misshapen flesh drags its heavy, pointed limbs behind it like an unwanted burden.  Formerly soft and vulnerable, bones grew around its form to protect it - only, they kept growing.  And growing.  And growing.
Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.
data.//: Matches armor value of an empty MBR vest.

data.description: This soldier zombie's skin radiates a sort of shadowy smoke that obscures its outline, making its camouflage even harder to see against the background.  In the darkness it would be nigh invisible.
Fragments of visible uniform hint that this monstrosity was once a soldier.  Anything human is invisible, hidden inside a sheath of living shadow.  It moves with preternatural fluidity and grace.

This staggering soldier wears a burnt gasmask, now fused to its face.  Through the melted, bile-encrusted ruination of the mask comes some sort of hardened fleshy proboscis, with steaming corrosive fluid leaking from the end.

special_attacks.description: The acid-sniper zombie launches a corrosive dart!

data.description: This zombie wears what appears to have once been a soldier's uniform and armor, now a series of cracked and melted plates that have fused to its skin and thickened hide.  Its face and arms blister with strange mutated tubes that pulse and drip with acid.

special_attacks.description: The acid-support zombie launches a hail of corrosive darts!

data.description: This zombie was once wearing some kind of uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  At this point it's impossible to tell what kind of uniform it was: the monster's skin has grown over the fabric, splitting and tearing it to shreds, turning the remaining Kevlar and other bits of armor material into part of its hide.  Its hands, similarly, have fused into large leathery cudgels.
data.//: Matches armor value of dragonskin vest.

data.description: This zombie was once wearing some kind of now long-shredded uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  It has grown into a hulking, leatherbacked beast, its mutated skin taking on a strange texture similar to the Kevlar bits embedded in it.  Its arms have twisted into enormous clubs of misshapen bone that it drags on the ground behind it.
data.//: Matches armor value of a hard-plated MBR vest.

data.description: Once a pilot, it is dressed in basic military fatigues, aviator sunglasses, and a sturdy looking helmet.

When bullets weren't enough to stop the end of the world, the military tried fire instead.  Their failure is made manifest in this gas-masked husk, its black suit torn and ripped.  Its flamethrower, dangling limply at its side, is attached to a tank of napalm strapped onto its back, which trickles its contents onto the ground.
Despite being encased in a what was once a nigh-impenetrable suit of power armor, something still managed to kill this soldier.
data.//: Armor values match that of salvaged and light power armor.

data.description: This armored and augmented soldier's bionics crackle with energy.  Worse, it appears to remember its training.
data.//: Little weaker than a soldier zombie, uses value of kevlar vest instead.

data.description: Once a highly trained soldier, various bionics cover this zombie's broken body.  Strangely, it maintains a vague martial arts stance.
Still wearing the tattered remnants of improvised armor and weaponry, it is plain to see that this zombie was once a survivor like you.
data.//: Armor values match that of light survivor body armor.

data.description: This zombie once was a survivor like you, and a pretty good one at that.  Unfortunately they didn't make it, despite the custom-made, heavy armor pieces they wear and the gear that they are still lugging around.
data.//: Armor values match that of survivor suit.
