A surprisingly compact 50-round helical magazine for use with the Calico M960 SMG.
An extended 30-round polymer magazine for use with Glock compatible firearms.
A compact light-weight polymer magazine for use with Glock compatible firearms.

A military issue 15-round box magazine originally intended for use with the Beretta M9 handgun.

The standard magazine for the Beretta Px4, in 9x19mm.

A 4L pressurized steel canister with a valve designed for the RM451's feed system.

data.//: Tileset whitelist for shotgun magazines and speedloaders
data.description: A non-disintegrating cloth ammo belt which can hold up to 20 shotgun shells.  Notably less reliable than metal ammo belts.

A plastic tube with a sliding handle that can be used to quickly load 6 rounds into a shotgun's tube in a much shorter period of time than by hand.  It needs to interface with a chute to be used with any speed.

A plastic tube with a sliding handle that can be used to quickly load 8 rounds into a shotgun's tube in a much shorter period of time than by hand.  It needs to interface with a chute to be used with any speed.
A compact steel cylinder designed for holding pressurized welding gases.  It is marked with several faded and now unreadable symbols.
A large steel cylinder designed for holding pressurized welding gases.  It is marked with several faded and now unreadable symbols.
This is a huge axe designed for warfare.  Though intended for use as a weapon, it can also be pressed into service as a rather clumsy woodcutting tool.
This is a huge axe designed for warfare.  You notice that the axe heads aren't seated properly at all.
This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a massive axe designed for warfare.
This is a versatile polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long stick.
This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long stick.
An improvised weapon, made from two spikes attached to a bowling pin in the shape of a 'T'.

This is a stout pole with a large steel flanged mace head on a short chain attached to it, based on the peasant flail agricultural tool except now with a metal head and made to thresh people in metal armor rather than grain.
This is a stout pole with a wooden club on a leather cord attached to it, once used as a tool used to thresh wheat and occasionally people when the peasants got angry at their feudal lords.
A sturdy wood bat.  Makes a great melee weapon.
An aluminum baseball bat, lighter than a wooden bat and a little easier to swing as a result.
A baseball bat made out of foam rubber with a plastic handle.  Light, well-balanced, and easy to wield, but almost completely ineffective.
A baseball bat wrapped with barbed wire.  A brutal melee weapon.
A baseball bat with several nails driven through it, an excellent melee weapon.
A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes an excellent melee weapon.  Activate to expand.

use_action.msg: You snap open your baton.

data.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes an excellent melee weapon.  Activate to collapse.

use_action.msg: You collapse your baton.

data.description: This is a short, easily concealed bludgeoning weapon consisting of a weight embedded at the end of a short leather shaft.  Formerly used by law enforcement, this weapon is meant to stun or knock out the subject, although head strikes have a high risk of causing a permanent, disabling brain injury or being fatal.

This is a solid wood 'training' katana, exactingly crafted to mimic the weight and balance of the real thing.  Despite its lack of a sharp metal edge, it's still quite capable of inflicting deadly wounds.
data.//: MA reference I used held that a bokken crushes rather than cuts (or impales) but is otherwise just as damaging as a katana.  Nerfed by popular demand.

data.description: This is a solid wood 'training' katana, but it looks to be mass-produced, and not quite as effective as the real deal.
This is a solid wood 'training' katana, but feels far too light to make an effective weapon.
A blunt bowling pin.  Makes a decent melee weapon, if somewhat short.
Handicapped or not, you always walk in style.  Consisting of a metal headpiece and a wooden body, this makes a great bashing weapon in a pinch.
A cane designed to conceal blade.  This was a popular fashion accessory for the wealthy during the 18th and 19th centuries.
A slender long rod of wood, while traditionally intended as a training tool for many dueling moves, it still makes a good melee weapon in a pinch.
A long handle with a big metal head, flat on one side, for driving golf balls.  Fore!
A large, heavy hammer.  Makes an acceptable melee weapon for the very strong, but is nearly useless in the hands of the weak.
A shorter sledge hammer, still as weighty, however, due to the same steel head.  Worse as a melee weapon but is a more portable tool.
A large sledge hammer with a massive, heavy head.  This unwieldy tool is meant to break concrete, rock, brick, anything really.
A stout and hefty hammer, more akin to a sledge than a typical ball-peen.  Useful for portable demolition work, but is very unwieldy as a weapon.
A curved wooden stick with a wide and flat end.  Commonly used by hockey players.
A long piece of wood with several chunks of steel firmly tied to it.  The resulting weapon is unwieldy and slow but very heavy hitting.

Produced by the Light corporation, this stylish staff not only functions as a light source, but doubles as a light-weight weapon, due to the superalloy materials it is made of.  Due to proprietary efficiency improvements over standard light sources, the L-stick or light stick as it is commonly called, batteries last longer than other light sources.

use_action.msg: The L-stick(tm) lights up.

data.description: Produced by the Light corporation, this stylish staff not only functions as a light source, but doubles as a light-weight weapon, due to the superalloy materials it is made of.  Due to proprietary efficiency improvements over standard light sources, the L-stick or light stick as it is commonly called, batteries last longer than other light sources.  The staff is glowing brightly, which is slowly draining the batteries.

use_action.msg: The l-stick(tm)'s light fades away.

data.description: This is a versatile polearm with a spiked hammer head, a spike, and a hook attached to a long stick.
This is a cheap piece of crap imitation of a versatile polearm with a spiked hammer head, probably used for LARPing.
A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy iron end.  It is heavy and slow, but its crushing damage is devastating.
data.//: Same total damage and slightly higher weight than a morningstar - exchanged.

data.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy iron end.  That iron end feels a bit loose.
A light, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon that would normally consist of a wood handle with a heavy iron end.
This is an improvised sap, also known as a cosh, slapjack and slapper.  A short and flat bludgeoning weapon consisting of a weight embedded between two patches of leather.

A large hammer, forged from the heart of a dying star.  It bears the inscription:

Whosoever holds this hammer,
If he be worthy,
Shall possess the power to…
CRUSH!'
A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.  It deals devastating crushing damage, with a small amount of piercing to boot.
A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.  That end feels lighter than it should.
A light, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon that would normally consist of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.
A long piece of wood with several nails through one end; essentially a simple mace.  Makes an acceptable melee weapon.
A hard-wood stick designed for hitting colorful balls around a felt table.  Truly, the coolest of sports.
The Monadnock PR-24 baton is a collapsible, lightweight, side-handle baton used by law enforcement all over the world.  The PR designation is rumored to mean Public Relations.  Activate to extend.

use_action.msg: You snap open your PR-24 baton.

data.description: The Monadnock PR-24 baton is a collapsible, lightweight, side-handle baton used by law enforcement all over the world.  The PR designation is rumored to mean Public Relations.  Activate to retract.

use_action.msg: You collapse your PR-24 baton.

data.description: A smooth and sturdy staff that was finely oiled and sanded for durability.  Light and well-balanced, it is surprisingly easy to handle.  Also sometimes referred to as a bō in Japan and Okinawan martial arts.
A smooth and sturdy staff with a leather-wrapped grip, which has been reinforced with metal bands and caps.  Durable and well-balanced, it is surprisingly easy to handle.

This is an ironshod quarterstaff that has a high-voltage stun gun built into the handle.  The stun gun is wired to the metal caps at either end of the staff, allowing you to zap a dangerous opponent with each strike.  It is currently off.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the staff crackles with electricity.

data.description: This is an ironshod quarterstaff that has a high-voltage stun gun built into the handle.  The stun gun is wired to the metal caps at either end of the staff, allowing you to zap a dangerous opponent with each strike.  It is currently on.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the staff turns off.

data.description: A pair of nested socks filled with a stone.  A true weapon of despair.

A stout knotty stick with a large knob at the top that has been left to cure in a chimney.  A traditional Irish weapon, the shillelagh was originally used for settling disputes in a gentlemanly manner.
A hollowed out wooden club that has been filled with lead or other easy to melt metals to make it more weighty; packs a surprising punch for how easy it is to make.
A fake shillelagh massproduced as a souvenir for tourists.  This knotty stick has not been cured in a chimney like a traditional shillelagh but has had fake black soot painted on.
A hard plastic truncheon commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

A stout wooden truncheon of the sort commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a carved stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

This is a reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is hollowed out and is filled with capacitors and a battery compartment.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the tonfa, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.  It's currently turned off.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the tonfa crackles with electricity.

data.description: A medieval hammer made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.
data.//: Craftable from steel, shouldn't be silver.  A warhammer is essentially one end of a pickaxe with balancing weight on the other and crushes/pierces the armor.

data.description: A custom-made telescoping steel quarterstaff, capable of shrinking down to the size of a baton for easy storage.  Its hollow nature makes it more lightweight but less sturdy than a more traditional staff.  It is currently retracted.

use_action.msg: You snap open your staff.

data.description: A custom-made telescoping steel quarterstaff, capable of shrinking down to the size of a baton for easy storage.  Its hollow nature makes it more lightweight but less sturdy than a more traditional staff.  It is currently extended.

use_action.msg: You retract your staff.

data.name: spiked survivor club
data.description: A wooden club with bands of iron or loops of wire and spikes carefully hammered onto it.  While it's not as effective or fancy as a proper mace or morningstar, its history throughout medieval and even early modern battlefields is noteworthy.  It was also known as a trench club during world war 1.
This hefty bludgeon is carved from sturdy bones mounted on a wooden haft, capable of bashing faces in with swiftness and efficiency.

data.name: spiked survivor staff
data.description: A wooden staff with metal bands or a length of wire wrapped onto both ends and various nails or spikes attached to it, including a single wicked spike at the top.  Makeshift weapons have a long history throughout warfare, from the trench clubs of World War 1 to the staffs used by medieval peasants, and hopefully it will help you survive too.
Short and sharp claws made from a high-tech metal and edged with bonded nanocrystals.
A foot-long blade made from high-tech alloy and edged with bonded nanocrystals.
A long, sharp thread of high-tech material, with a small counterweight at the end.
generic item template
This is a sharp, heavy knife.  It makes a good melee weapon, and is an ideal item for butchering corpses.
This is a sharp knife, designed for cutting meat.  It makes a poor melee weapon, but is decent at butchering corpses.
This is a short-bladed knife with a sharp blade, made for fine controlled cuts to vegetables without using a cutting board.

This is a long-bladed kitchen knife.  The blade is wider than the handle, giving room for the wielder's knuckles, and it has a characteristic curve for a fast rocking action for chopping vegetables.  It makes a good melee weapon, but the wide blade is unwieldy for butchering.

This is a long-bladed kitchen knife with a thin, slightly curved blade for deftly slicing meat either in flat sheets or around the bone.  It would be a decent melee weapon, and excellent for butchery.
This knife has quite a long blade with a scalloped edge for cutting bread.  It's not that sharp, but its length and heft mean it could do a bit of damage and cause some nasty tearing.

This is a menacing looking knife with a broad, square shaped blade, curved for fast vegetable chopping.  Its heft and sharpness would make it a decent weapon as well, although not as good as a meat cleaver.
This is a menacing looking knife with a broad, square shaped blade.  Its heft and sharpness would make it a very effective melee weapon, and an excellent butchering tool.

A long strip of braided leather with a handle on one end.  Originally developed to settle disagreements with cattle, it's better used now for flaying the rotten flesh off of walking corpses.  Great for when a problem comes along.
data.//: A bullwhip's damage comes from the genuine miniature sonic boom it creates when you swing it fast enough, so it can actually harm something with a near-miss and can literally pop open the skin.

data.description: The "cat 'o nine tails", a handle with nine short leather whips each sporting a razor-sharp metal tip.  This ancient instrument of torture causes massive bleeding but is an ineffecient weapon by design.
data.//: There's no way you can swing this thing without hitting SOMETHING.

data.description: This is a hand-forged collapsible tool that has two axe heads and sharp shovel-like tip on one end.  It can be used as a shovel, or you could chop some zombies with it instead.
A glass shard with wrapping at one end so it can be safely wielded.
An oblong plastic trinket with the far end ground down into a stabbing point.

This is a high-powered stun gun.  Use this item to attempt to electrocute an adjacent enemy, damaging and temporarily paralyzing them.  Because the shock can actually jump through the air, it is difficult to miss.
An agricultural tool with long wooden shaft and four spikes.  Is used to lift hay.
A simple wood pole with one end sharpened.
A stout wood pole with one end sharpened.  More clunky than a properly-made spear, but still has some heft to it.
A stout pole with an improvised grip and a fire-hardened point.
A flimsy pole made of wood with a basic metal spike tied to it.  It's barely sharp, and crudely constructed, but it will keep the zombies out of arm's reach until you can find something better.

A flimsy pole made of wood with a knife bound to the end.  It's long enough to slice from a distance, but the knife isn't that well attached.  You could take a bit more time to carefully split the shaft and attach the knife blade more permanently.
A sturdy wooden pole that has been carefully split and reinforced.  At the split point, a sharp blade has been bolted into place and reinforced with layers of sturdy wrapped bindings.

A short do-it-yourself spear made out of a smooth wooden shaft with a metal spike seated and bound into place at its tip.  Its functional grip and decent construction makes it a usable, if not effective, weapon.
A wooden pole with three spikes tied to it and decent grip.  It's specialized for catching weapons.
A stout metal pole with a sharp point.
A stout wooden pole with a spearhead worked from copper.
A stout wooden pole with a hand-forged steel spearhead.
A somewhat sharpened piece of rebar.
A stout wooden pole with a sharp stone spearhead.
An ancient Chinese spear, typically with a tassel just below the spearhead.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao sabre, jian sword, and gun staff.
This farming tool has been modified into an improvised weapon by rotating its blade 90 degrees, transforming it into a deadly giant blade on the end of a stick.  However it's quite fragile.
A pole weapon with a curving single-edged blade.  Its blade bears some superficial resemblance to that of an agricultural scythe from which it likely evolved.

data.//: Name changed to glaive, but changing the id would break e.g.  tilesets.
data.description: This is a large blade attached to a long stick.  It could do a considerable amount of damage.
A sturdy polearm with a sizable, single-edged blade on the end.
A sturdy polearm with a curved blade, made in the same manner as the katana and other Japanese blades.  Occasionally used by samurai in early periods, or by their wives in defense of the household.
A sturdy polearm with a curved blade, made in the same manner as the katana and other Japanese blades.  This one has a bit of wiggle to its blade and feels a bit shoddily made.
This is a dull, slightly floppy replica of a Japanese polearm with a curved blade.  With a little difficulty, you could use it administer a solid slap from a distance.
This sturdy steel shaft with a sword blade at the end is good for both slashing and stabbing.
data.//: Description says it can slash. STAB currently doesn't slash, but at least it doesn't give the spear bonus

data.description: A fire-hardened wooden spear honed to a sharper point.  The grip area has been carved and covered for better grip.
An iron-tipped wooden throwing spear.  The grip area has been carved and covered for better grip.
This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft with a fire hardened point.
This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with a copper spearhead.
This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.
This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.  The head seems to be pretty dull, and the whole thing feels poorly made.
This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.
A well-made spear with a bronze head, Greek in origin.

data.//: Couldn't find a good way to pluralize the transliteration.
data.description: This is a bronze polearm that originated in the Shang dynasty of China, if not earlier.  It combines a spear head with the perpendicular blade of the earlier ge or dagger-axe.
A custom 3D-printed spear made out of carbon fiber.  It is more lightweight than a normal spear thanks to its method of manufacturing, but it can only be repaired using a 3D printer.
A stout wooden pole with several razor-sharp teeth set into the edges of its spearhead.
data.//: Could drag material to be cut along the teeth but manhandling it for butchery or fine work might be too much.

data.description: A stout wooden pole with a sharpened mutant insect stinger for a spearhead, to add a venomous touch to a classic weapon.

hit_you_effect.message: The stinger injects a small amount of poison into your target.

data.description: A stout wooden pole tipped with a stinger from a strange plant monster.  An alien twist on hunting with poison-tipped weapons made from natural sources.

hit_you_effect.message: The stinger injects a small amount of poison into your target.

data.description: This glaive's blade is carved from a large chunk of bone, and is capable of slicing foes in with swiftness and efficiency.
A two by four with a cross guard and whittled down point; not much for slashing, but a sharp point is better than nothing.
The nail sword, or nord for short.  This wooden sword has a dozen nails sticking out at jagged angles from the edge of the blade, adding a bit of piercing to its swings.
Several bits of thin scrap metal crudely beat into the semblance of an edge over a wooden sword.  The added weight is unbalanced, but the jagged edge offers a good bit of slashing power.

A simple, no-frills handmade sword.  Not accurate to any historical style, and the blade profile isn't as well-balanced as the real deal, but it's more than serviceable in the right hands.  It's just hefty enough to require a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.
This is a long and thin knife with a spring-loaded blade that rests inside the handle while not in use.
This is a small folding knife, with a locking blade and a pocket clip.  Not as good a weapon as a solid fixed-blade knife, but better than a penknife.
This is a military combat knife.  It is light and extremely sharp, and could be deadly in either the right hands or when attached as a bayonet.

This is a military combat knife.  It is light and extremely sharp, and could be deadly in either the right hands or when attached as a bayonet.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

data.//: Highest non-powertool butchering quality.  It's made for skinning and butchering game, which is what you're generally doing.
data.description: Commonly used by hunters, this single-edge sheath knife is designed for cutting and skinning game rather than combat.

data.//: This isn't really supposed to be a very good knife, or a very good saw.  It's more for looking scary.
data.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.

This sturdy matte black Rivtech combat dagger features a long and slim double-edged blade with a spear-point and a distinctive slip-resistant grip which can also be used to affix it to a suitable firearm.  Originally manufactured for the military, it was very popular in films and among collectors due to its fearsome appearance.

data.//: The swiss army knife is a bit more of a knife than a toolkit.
data.description: An iconic pocket knife imported from Europe.  Its red plastic handle conceals many small tools.
This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking, and the knife can also be used to butcher corpses.
A knife consisting of a long, somewhat sharpened, spike and a tightly wrapped rag as a handle.  It makes a good melee weapon.
A femur or other bone, at least 30 cm long, which has been broken at one end and sharpened into a cutting tool.  Its jagged edge is wicked but fragile.
data.//: literally 75% of a bone.

data.description: A medieval dagger forged from rough iron.  It is not the sharpest tool in the shed, but it is certainly one of the largest.
This huge steel knife makes an excellent tool for cutting down large vegetation or other 'obstacles.'
This is a large blade that has had a portion of the handle wrapped in duct tape, making it easier to wield as a rough machete.
A thin, wobbly steel blade with sawteeth on one side and a flat chisel tip for digging.  A jack of many trades and a master of none.
This is a curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight but a deadly slashing weapon.
This is a dull, cheap replica of a curved sword associated with cavalry, from the Early Modern period onwards.
This wavy bladed dagger comes from Southeast Asia.  The design of the blade causes it to make broad, painful wounds.
This is a dull, cheap replica of a wavy bladed dagger that comes from Southeast Asia.
This versatile implement is a modern take on a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly curved edge, it is used as both a tool and as a weapon.

This is an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao sabre, qiang spear, and gun staff.
This is an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword.  The sword is quite worn, and bent at an odd angle.
This is a dull, cheaply made replica of an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard.
This is a curved sword associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.  Designed for slashing, and quite deadly against unarmored targets.
This is a curved sword associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.  This one seems oddly dull and worn.
This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a curved sword, associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.
This is a thin, edgeless thrusting sword, a sort of predecessor to the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.
This is a thin, edgeless thrusting sword, a sort of predecessor to the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.  It seems a bit too bendy.
This is a dull, cheaply-made replica of a thin, edgeless thrusting sword predating the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.
This is a classic medieval sword, in between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.
This is a classic medieval sword, in between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  You feel like the pommel could just snap off if you used it.
This is a dull, cheaply-made replica of the classic medieval longsword.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.
This is a classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed.
This is a classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed.  This one doesn't seem to have been made right.
This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed.
A bronze sword of ancient Greek origin, wielded as a sidearm to the dory spear.

This ancient bronze weapon features a curved, sickle-like blade sharpened on the outside edge.  Associated with the New Kingdom period of Ancient Egypt, it was designed mainly to hack through the light armor common to the region.

An ancient Chinese sword consisting of a curved blade and a guard with a cupped design.  Existing since the Shang dynasty, this one is made of bronze.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the jian sword, qiang spear, and gun staff.
This common gardening tool has been customized and rebalanced to improve its performance as a weapon.
A sword bayonet is a large slashing weapon that can be attached to the front of a firearm or crossbow converting it into a pike.

A sword bayonet is a large slashing weapon that can be attached to the front of a firearm or crossbow converting it into a pike.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and SMGs, if you so want.

Long Japanese knives like this more-modern remake were the samurai's backup weapon, before the advent of the larger wakizashi.  It's still a deadly blade, even if it's smaller than its more famous relatives.
Long Japanese knives like this more-modern remake were the samurai's backup weapon, before the advent of the larger wakizashi.  This one doesn't feel well-balanced.
This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a long Japanese knife, typically used as a samurai's backup weapon.
This is a comparatively-common Japanese short sword.  Smaller and lighter than a katana, but still effective in combat.
This is a comparatively-common Japanese short sword.  There's something not quite right about this sword.
This is a dull, cheap replica of the more common wakizashi.  Smaller and lighter than a katana, but still effective in combat.
This is a huge two-handed sword from Germany.  It packs a real wallop.

A broken ceramic shard.  It is heavy and has a somewhat sharp edge, but it's too irregular to cut properly.

Material from an incendiary round, useful in constructing incendiary ammunition.
This is a single, or twin, sized mattress.
This is a single, or twin, sized down filled mattress.
A piece of fuse, long enough to give you enough time to get away from most explosions.
A rock with sharp edges, that can be used as a butchering tool, if nothing else is available.  Makes a passable melee weapon.
A collapsible buttstock designed for the M320 grenade launcher.  When combined with this stock, the M320 can be used as a standalone weapon
A six-inch stinger from a giant wasp.  Makes a poor melee weapon.
A metal case tightly packed with gunpowder and an impact fuse.  With some gunpowder, wadding, and a fuse, it could be prepared to load into a cannon.
A four-pound, cast-iron cannonball.  With some gunpowder, wadding, and a fuse, it could be prepared to load into a cannon.
A mattress made of wool.  It is quite soft and comfortable.
This is a piece of plastic.  It could be used to fabricate, repair, or reinforce plastic items.
A spool of fine carbon filament, used to make lightweight yet strong items.  Very useful if you can get your hands on a 3D printer, more advanced models might even allow you to make more.
This is small bolt of synthetic fabric.  Unlike you and other natural materials, it won't degrade much with age.  Maybe that's less of a bad thing now.
This is a large sheet of heavy flexible plastic, the sort that might have been used for commercial wrapping or for weather-sealing a home.

data.name: rigid plastic sheet
data.description: A large, rigid sheet of translucent plastic, useful for all manner of things; from construction to art, or even junior snowboarding.
This is a tiny piece of plastic.  Useless on its own, but could be melted down if you gather enough.
A large chunk of log, cut from a tree.  (a)ctivate a wood axe or wood saw to cut it into planks.
A splintered piece of wood, could be used as a skewer or for kindling.
A sturdy, heavy stick.  Makes a decent melee weapon.
A long stick.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be broken into heavy sticks for crafting.
A stout, ten-foot pole.  Could be used similarly to a spear.  The Cataclysm gives fresh meaning to walking softly and carrying a big stick.
data.//: a long pole is a single piece of wood, and the heavy stick just isn't large enough.

data.description: A narrow, thick plank of wood, like a 2 by 4 or similar piece of dimensional lumber.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be used for all kinds construction.
An enormous beam of solid wood, very heavy and hard to lug around, but also very sturdy for construction.  You could saw or chop it into smaller pieces, like planks or panels.
data.//: weight for a roughly 6x6x8 wooden beam. Probably a bit small tbh.

data.description: A wide, thin wooden board - plywood, OSB, MDF, tongue-in-groove boards, or similar, already cut to shape.  These large flat boards are good for all kinds of construction, but for really big projects you'd need a proper sheet of uncut plywood or the like.
data.//: Weight and volume assumes 18 square feet of 1/2 inch plywood.  The actual size of the panel likely varies wildly and the item entry may represent several smaller pieces.

data.description: A standard 4x8 sheet of flat wood - usually plywood, OSB, or MDF.  Heavy and bulky, this is extremely useful for all manner of construction, but you might have to cut it to size before doing smaller projects.
data.//: Weight and volume assumes 32 square feet of 1/2 inch plywood.  Due to its enormously bulky shape, volume is higher than actual displacement volume

data.description: A hunk of dried plant matter condensed into a puck, then dried.  It burns well.
A stainless steel water bottle, holds 750ml of liquid.
A non-rigid plastic bottle for easy storage, holds 500 ml of liquid.

This is a Curie-G coffeemaker, by CuppaTech.  It famously uses a radioactive generator to heat water for coffee.  Normally the water is heated using energy stored in a capacitor, and makes ordinary coffee.  However, as a special feature, water from the RTG containment area can be used, giving the coffee a very special kick.  The Curie-G is illegal in most countries.
data.//: It would be nice if this could have a use action to thaw frozen stuff.  It's not hot enough to work as a hotplate.

data.description: This is a kit containing all the specialized knives you need to debone, skin, and prepare cuts of meat from an animal.
This is a crafting_pseudo_item if you have it something is wrong.
A hand crank powered cast steel machine designed to automatically seal tin cans.
An electric meat carver powered by batteries.  Two serrated blades that vibrate together to slice just about anything from turkey to ham… even zombies!

use_action.msg: You turn on the electric carver.

data.description: This carver is on and the blades are buzzing.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the electric carver.

data.description: Using this item on a container full of water will purify the water using layered charcoal.  Once the charcoal has purified enough water, it will become unusable and can be disassembled and recycled.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.
This is a portable charcoal smoker.  Good for weekend barbecuing and preserving meat with smoke.
This is a little metal tank for holding charcoal with a pilot light attached.  You could use it for cooking food.
A crude clay pot with lid used for cooking.
This is a simple hand-powered clay quern for grinding grain.
A clay teapot.  Now all you need is tea and water.

This is a heating element with pot and frame for holding coffee or other powders.  It's got a battery compartment for use when the power goes out.  You can use it to make coffee, or other drinks if you so choose.
This is a portable electric food dehydrator.  It's powered by batteries, and could be invaluable in preserving food.
This jar contains a batch of eggs in a pickling solution.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You examine the batch and see that the pickling solution has done its job, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The eggs are not done yet.

data.description: Known as an Esbit stove, this is a lightweight, folding stove designed to use small hexamine tablets for cooking.
A sealed flask holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

use_action.msg: You open the flask and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.
use_action.//: 12 hours

use_action.//: 24 hours

use_action.msg: You open the jar and harvest the culture.

data.description: This is a kitchen appliance capable of slicing, chopping, shredding, grinding, pureeing and mixing.
This is a simple heater powered by gasoline.  It is designed for cooking food.
This is a chemical heat pack.  It's used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  It is usable only once.
This is a small heating element on a stand, powered by batteries.  It is indispensable for cooking and chemistry.  Try not to burn yourself.
This is a sealed glass jar containing pickled eggs.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the jar, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing pickles.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the jar, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing sauerkraut.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the jar, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.description: This is a homemade heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.

A self-contained camping mess kit, containing everything you might need for wilderness cooking.  This model relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the more commonplace chemical-fueled Esbit stove.

A compact military-style pan and tray, designed for heating food over a fire or portable stove.  It is shallower than a proper pot or pan, and lacks the integrated heating elements modern mess kits have.

Military mess kit designed for long-range reconnaissance patrols deployed behind enemy lines.  All parts are made from thin sheet of aluminum / superalloy composite and are insulated with ceramic coating.  Relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the smoke-producing chemical-fueled Esbit stove.  Compact, durable and lightweight.
This is a simple combination of a small grindstone and a bowl-shaped stone.  Used for grinding grain, but time-consuming compared to more complex methods.

A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating.  Its multitude of settings and features promise to handle any sort of cooking, from parboiling potatoes to cooking curry to popping popcorn.  There's no manual, but you're sure you can work it out.
A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating.  There is a dish in it.
This is a simple heater powered by lamp oil.  It is designed for cooking food.
A pasta extruder run by a hand-crank.  Useful in making pasta.  It comes with various heads to make various kinds of pasta.
This jar contains a batch of pickles set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The pickles are not done fermenting yet.
use_action.//: 2 1/3 days, from the suggested recipie of 1 rl week

data.//: Should be 20 but currently recipes do not utilize this value
data.description: This is an ultra-light alcohol-burning stove with simmer ring.  It comes with a 500 ml container to hold concentrated alcohol fuel.
Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.  This sealed pot is designed to cook food at higher pressures and temperatures.  Can also be used for pressure sensitive chemical reactions.
This is a simple hand-powered stone quern for grinding grain.
This jar contains a batch of sauerkraut set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The sauerkraut isn't done fermenting yet.
use_action.//: 2 1/3 days, from the suggested recipie of 1 rl week

data.description: This is a still.  It's useful for creating distillation of alcohol and other, more curious substances.
This is a primitive distillation tool made from clay, with a long neck that acts as a condenser.
This is a primitive distillation tool made from copper, with a long neck that acts as a condenser.
A homemade mess kit, containing everything you might need for creating post-apocalyptic cuisine.  Powered by a lamp oil burner, it is composed of simple yet durable tools and materials.
A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.
This is a portable heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.
A waffle iron.  For making waffles.

This is a battery-powered device designed to purify drinking water.  Using this item on a container full of water will purify the contents.  It could be useful for water taken from uncertain sources like a river, as it may be non-potable.

A dok, or clay jar, in which kimchi is stored for the winter.  Traditionally, this is buried in the ground, but it doesn't matter if you leave it above ground; just close the lid and wait for it to ferment, and you'll have delicious kimchi.

use_action.msg: You lift the lid and the smell of tangy, spicy, ripe kimchi makes you salivate.
use_action.not_ready_msg: This kimchi is not done fermenting yet.

data.description: A large metal stand used to contain a fire.  Fires set in a brazier will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.
This is a small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can or similar container of the right size.  It's too small to fit anything much larger than splintered wood.  Activate it to Deploy.
A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.
A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.
Folded camp chair, deploy to sit down.
This is a military style fold up cot.  While it may not be quite as comfortable as a bed, it's better than slumming it on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unfold the cot and place it on the ground.

data.description: This is a bicycle folded into a relatively portable package.

use_action.unfold_msg: You painstakingly unfold the bicycle and make it ready to ride.

data.description: This is a skateboard.

use_action.unfold_msg: You lay the skateboard down on the ground.

data.description: seeing this is a bug
Metal butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.  It is folded for easy transportation.
This rubber rowboat (oars included) is deflated for storage.  Activate it (having an air pump in inventory) to inflate and launch.

use_action.unfold_msg: You painstakingly unfold, inflate, and launch the %s.

data.description: A metal rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  It is folded for easy transportation.
Metal tourist table for off-road trips.  It is folded for easy transportation.
A large sheet of sewn leather that can be deployed instead of a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a butchery appliance as it does not soak in blood.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.

A large mat woven from fibrous material that can be used instead of a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a butchery appliance.  Too thin to be used as a comfortable sleeping place.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.
A large wooden container used to turn raw milk into butter and buttermilk.  This model uses a foot crank and holds three gallons of raw milk.
A small water-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Can be placed via the construction menu.
A small wind-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Can be placed via the construction menu.
Folded plastic chair on a metal frame, deploy to sit down.

This is an advanced version of the unified power supply, or UPS.  Designed for military use to power advanced weapons, it uses plutonium fuel cells which provide better efficiency, but are not rechargeable.  It can power many household electronics as well.

A point-and-shoot digital camera, with digital viewfinder, a backup 'iron-sight', and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen, or transfer them with a memory card.  Takes conventional batteries.

A 35 mm digital SLR (single-lens reflex) camera, with optical and digital viewfinders, zoom lens with auto-focus and stabilizer, and flash.  You can view your photos on it or transfer them with a memory card; it runs on a rechargeable power cell that can be switched to charge via Unified Power Supply.  Before the Cataclysm, you could have taken professional-grade photos using this.

This is a cellphone, an older cousin of a smartphone but still popular in certain circles due to its reliability, sturdiness and the ability to run on common batteries.  Using this cellphone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is sufficiently charged.  It also has a clock app that includes an alarm.

use_action.msg: You light up the screen.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The cellphone's batteries need more charge.

use_action.msg: You stop lighting up the screen.

data.description: A modified laptop, now capable of transmitting in the ultra-high frequencies utilized by robots.  Activate it to command robots from afar, or to toggle charging via UPS.
This is an antenna designed to pick up signals better when pointed at the source.  You could use this with a radio to receive faint signals.

A pair of electronic handcuffs, used by police and riot bots to detain captives.  Their continuous siren clearly identifies the wearer as an arrested criminal and alerts human police.  Wait for their arrival, don't try to escape or to remove the cuffs - they will administer an electric shock.
However, since the only police likely to respond are undead, you may have a long wait ahead, unless you get creative…

A tablet PC using an efficient color e-ink display, with a recharging battery that can be switched to draw from a UPS.  Before the Cataclysm, these were nifty gadgets; now, it's an almost priceless resource.

This device has many ports attached, allowing it to connect to almost any control panel or other electronic machine (but not computers).  With a little skill, it can be used to crack passwords and more.  It requires 25 charges of battery power per use.

This is a tool for measuring radiation.  Using it will prompt you to choose whether to scan yourself or the terrain, or to turn it on, which will provide continuous feedback on ambient radiation.  It is currently off.

This is a tool for measuring radiation.  It is in continuous scan mode, and will produce quiet clicking sounds in the presence of ambient radiation.  Using it allows you to turn it off, or scan yourself or the ground.  It is currently on.
This is a hand-powered battery charger.  It has an adjustable receptacle designed to accept a wide variety of rechargeable battery cells.

data.name: laptop computer
data.description: A laptop computer with an internal rechargeable battery, also capable of using UPS.

use_action.msg: You light up the screen.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The laptop's batteries need more charge.

use_action.msg: You stop lighting up the screen.

data.description: This battery-powered device is loaded up with someone's music collection.  Fortunately, there's lots of songs you like, and listening to it will raise your morale slightly.  Use it to turn it on, or toggle charging on the go from a Unified Power System.

This mp3 player is turned on and playing some great tunes, raising your morale steadily while on your person.  It runs through batteries quickly; you can turn it off by using it.  It also obscures your hearing.

This device was constructed by 'enhancing' a speaker ripped off from some electronic device with some amplifier circuits.  It has now no other use beside emitting loud crackling static noise, that could distract zombies.
This device has been turned on and is emitting horrible crackles, pops and other static sounds.  Quick, get away from it before it draws zombies to you!

This is a portable games console in working condition, with an LED-screen allowing you to play in the dark.  You can use it to play it for a little while, running down the integrated battery.  Can also be set to draw power from a UPS.

A popular, fancy smartphone.  Capable of making photos due to integrated camera and illuminating an area as per flashlight app, assuming it has enough charge.  The smartphone also has a clock app that includes an alarm.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with Unified Power Supply if set to charge from one.

use_action.msg: You activate the flashlight app.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The smartphone's charge is too low.

data.description: This phone is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

use_action.msg: You deactivate the flashlight app.

data.description: This is a unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a civilian evolution of a military project.  Designed to power advanced weapons and armor, the civilian version serves as a portable power bank and inverter for many household electronics.
This battery-devouring device is just the thing to knead the tension out and help you relax.  Use it to take a break and unwind.
A small metal scanner specialized in detecting bionic hardware.  Activate to start scanning nearby corpses for bionics.

use_action.msg: You start scanning for bionics.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The scanner doesn't have enough power.

data.description: A small metal scanner specialized in detecting bionic hardware.  While in use it will steadily drain power, automatically scanning corpses near you for bionics.
This is a hefty prying tool.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

This is a metal hairpin bent into shape by hand, worse than an improvised set but easier to work with than a bone skewer.  You need MacGyver-like skills to open locks with this as it is brittle, but it lowers the chance of an alarm being set off.  If you're crouched, examining a locked door will have you prioritize picking the lock instead of using a crowbar on it.

This is an improvised set of picks and torsion wrenches made from scrap metal.  You need MacGyver-like skills to open locks with these as they are brittle, but they lower the chances of alarms being set off.  If you're crouched, examining a locked door will have you prioritize picking the lock instead of using a crowbar on it.
This is an ice axe with hammer on its head, a multi-purpose hiking and climbing tool used by mountaineers.  It is sturdy enough to pry open closed doors or lift manhole covers.

This is a pipe whose ends have been bent and hammered flat to resemble a crowbar.  Use it to open locked crates without destroying them, to lift manhole covers, or even open doors and windows.  You could also wield it to fight with, in a pinch.

This is a locksmith's set of sturdy steel lock picks and torsion wrenches.  It is essential for silently and quickly opening locks, provided you have some mechanical skill.  If you're crouched, examining a locked door will have you prioritize picking the lock instead of using a crowbar on it.
this a pseudo item
This item, which shouldn't exist, has shrapnel range larger than the reality itself.
This is a fragile container filled with acid.  Throw it to spill out a pool of potent acid.
This is a tin can filled with some explosives provided with a fuse.  Won't make a big explosion but you still wouldn't want to be near it.  Will explode in 5 seconds if lit.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the can bomb.  Throw it before it blows in your face!

data.description: This is a tin can filled with some explosives and provided with a fuse.  Won't make a big explosion but you still wouldn't want to be near it.  The fuse has been lit, you should throw it.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - what are you waiting for?

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

use_action.msg: You light the dynamite.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

data.description: This substantial device is a bomb that generates an electromagnetic pulse.  When this magnetic field is fed into the antenna, it creates a strong electro-magnetic pulse.  It will also create a sizable explosion, so stay clear of it.

use_action.msg: You activate the EMP bomb.

data.description: This EMP bomb is active, and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.  It will also create an explosion, which may hurt you.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already activated the %s, try throwing it instead.

data.description: This is a improvised demolition charge.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  20 seconds after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

data.description: A solitary firecracker with a short fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse it will explode, so throw it quickly!
A firecracker that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw it quickly before it explodes.

This is a pack of 25 firecrackers with a starter fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse they will begin to explode, so throw them quickly!
A pack of 25 firecrackers that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw them quickly before the start to explode.

This is a military police style flashbang.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it detonates with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening and disorienting anyone nearby.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the flashbang.

data.description: This flashbang is active, and will soon detonate with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening and disorienting anyone nearby.  It may be a good idea to throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.

data.description: This is a canister grenade filled with fungicidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active fungicidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to fungal life forms.
This fungicidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic gas.

This is a makeshift canister grenade filled with fungicidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active fungicidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to fungal life forms.
This makeshift fungicidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic haze.

This is a crude gasbomb using household chemicals.  Use this item to arm it.  In three turns it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for a short time.  This gas poisons those exposed to it, in addition to obscuring vision and scent.

use_action.msg: You arm the makeshift gas canister.

data.description: This homemade canister of poison gas has been unsealed, and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly toxic gas.  You should consider getting rid of it soon.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already armed the %s, try throwing it instead.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the grenade.

data.description: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin; try throwing it instead.

data.description: This is a grenade that generates an electromagnetic pulse with a low-inductance capacitor bank discharged into a single-loop antenna.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active EMP grenade.  You will then have three turns before it detonates, creating an EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.

data.description: This is an active incendiary grenade, likely to burst into an inferno any second now.  Better throw it!

In five turns it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for some time.  This gas damages and slows those who enter it, as well as obscuring vision and scent.
This smoke bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic gas.

This is a canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to insect life forms.
This insecticidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic haze.

This is a makeshift canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to insect life forms.
